macro.description: 「由 p, q, … 可推出所需结论」— each premise is its own child, so a transitivity chain is a list rather than a sentence. The separator is explicit: `#*` concatenates its children with nothing in between unless one is set, which ran the premises together as `\eta_2>-a\xi>\eta_2…`.

styles.template: 由 #* 可推出所需结论
